label: Selected-world one-way contract: each individual represented as…, by Universal instantiation…
rule: Universal instantiation, existential elimination, modus ponens
meaning: Derives the selected-world esse contract (every existent at w is in act of esse) from the OPEN premise that every existent at w is in act in some respect and the q.4 a.1 ad 3 reading that whatever is in act in some respect is in act of esse. Only the one-way contract follows; existence from esse is not derived.
